_comment: Machine-readable half of the core-versus-mod matrix (#897) and of the mod activation contract (#1091, ADR_1054 §2). Every NoöPunk overlay is listed here, none may claim the baseline, and each declares its hooks, state, dependencies, off-switch and tabletop procedure. `src/rules/mod_boundary.py::validate_registry` is the check.

gap_fill: Stars Without Number Revised: psionics, whole procedure

mods.name: noosphere_psyche
mods.summary: Noosphere exposure, ontological shock, Psyche instability and recovery
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure: the overlay is playable only through the Godot UI today

core: CWN mental save - the caller resolves it

off_switch.name: campaign_flag
off_switch.note: denies psychic access; exposure and tier still accrue

mods.name: ideology_factions
mods.summary: Discursive identification, faction standings, antagonisms and political temptation
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure: discourse positions are a MUD model, not a table procedure

core: CWN reaction roll outcome - the mod reads it, never rolls it

off_switch.gap: always active in the MUD; no constructor flag exists

mods.name: relationships_reputation
mods.summary: NPC trust, obligations, social capital, institutional standing
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure: the reaction modifier table lives in docs/rules only

core: CWN 2d6 reaction roll - the mod supplies a modifier only

off_switch.gap: always active in the MUD; no constructor flag exists

mods.name: investigative_mode
mods.summary: Clue discovery and synthesis; essential clues are never gated behind one failed roll

core: CWN skill check outcome - investigation spends points around it

off_switch.gap: no flag: the layer is either present in the scene data or not

mods.name: vices_temptations
mods.summary: Career ambition, status, trauma, corruption and solidarity as recurring pressures
mods.tabletop_gap: documented in the registry and nowhere else - no code, no procedure

off_switch.gap: nothing to switch off: no implementation exists

mods.name: awn_stress
mods.summary: Ashes Without Number Stress, Breakdowns, Hardening and the opt-in addiction submodule
mods.adds: character state only - a Stress meter, consequence codes and the modifiers the table applies; CWN attributes, checks, saves, combat and progression are untouched
mods.tabletop_gap: contract is procedure-only; no printed Stress procedure exists yet

core: CWN Mental save - the overlay flags it, the caller rolls it
